notes.title: Wishlist Now: Miami Paradise Awaits!
notes.content:
[h1] 🚨 NEW GAME ALERT: Miami Paradise 🚨 [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658579/83e5d05865f7d132ea2f279eafb54d8947df8c96.png[/img]
The countdown to paradise has officially started! EntropyDE is bringing the heat with their upcoming game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3403720/Miami_Paradise/]Miami Paradise[/url]. Get ready for an unforgettable adventure in the sunny streets of Miami — it’s going to be one steamy ride! 🌴🏊🚑

[h2] About Miami Paradise [/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3403720/Miami_Paradise/
[b]Miami Paradise: A Mature Open-World RPG[/b]

Immerse yourself in the lively, sun-soaked streets of Miami, where romance, adventure, and drama come together in a 3D open-world RPG. You’ll meet a cast of unforgettable characters, build deep relationships, and explore iconic locations like neon-lit clubs, sandy beaches, and extravagant mansions. Your choices will shape every moment, leading to wild encounters, emotional stories, and jaw-dropping surprises.

[h2] Key Features [/h2]
[list]
[*] 🔥 [b]Make Bold Choices[/b]: Every decision you make will drive the story in exciting directions.
[*] 👩‍💋 [b]Irresistible Characters[/b]: Forge relationships with stunning, unique characters — and discover their secrets.
[*] 🌟 [b]Explore Miami[/b]: From the buzzing nightlife to luxurious mansions and breathtaking beaches, Miami is yours to discover.
[*] 🎥 [b]Stunning Visuals[/b]: Enjoy high-quality animations and immersive storytelling that make every moment unforgettable.
[/list]
This isn’t just a game — it’s your ticket to an electrifying journey filled with love, power, and mystery. What will your Miami story be?

[hr][/hr]
🎉[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3403720/Miami_Paradise/ style=button]Wishlist Miami Paradise now![/url] 🎉
It helps us out and guarantees you’ll be the first to know when the game drops.

💬 Don’t forget to join the fun in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/MyxHZE8PMv style=button]Discord[/url]! Share your thoughts, ask questions, and connect with other fans as we gear up for launch.

📢 [b]Let’s turn up the heat in Miami![/b]

notes.title: Developer Update: Exciting News for Deadrock Redemption Fans!
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow gamers!

We're thrilled to announce a significant milestone in the development of Deadrock Redemption: the release of our small single quest demo featuring one of the captivating characters from the game, Amber!

As you dive into this exclusive demo, you'll get a taste of the immersive world of Deadrock and a glimpse into the compelling narrative that awaits in the full release. Join Amber on a thrilling quest that will test your wit, courage, and resolve as you navigate the rugged terrain of Deadrock.

But that's not all! We're gearing up for the highly anticipated full release of Deadrock Redemption on March 14. Mark your calendars, because this is an adventure you won't want to miss!

And here's the cherry on top: in anticipation of the full release, we're offering a special 15% launch discount to players who Wishlist Deadrock Redemption on their preferred gaming platform. That's right, by Wishlist-ing now, you'll not only secure your copy of the game but also enjoy exclusive savings on launch day!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2753270/Deadrock_Redemption/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2753270/Deadrock_Redemption/[/url]

So, what are you waiting for? Embark on the journey of a lifetime, explore the vast wilderness of Deadrock, and uncover the secrets that lie beneath its rugged exterior.

Wishlist Deadrock Redemption today and prepare to experience an unforgettable adventure on March 14!

Stay tuned for more updates and exciting announcements as we count down to launch day.

Happy gaming!

The Deadrock Redemption Development Team

notes.title: Curse of Black Bone 1.1 Girl/Girl Bonus Scene Content Update
notes.content:
This major content update to Curse of Black Bones adds a bonus girl/girl and solo Shona pirate appearance scene released today. This now adds the first all female NSFW scene to our game and features this all new character that could previously only be seen in teaser pre-release image content. We are sharing 2 high resolution fully animated sequences as new bonus content to all customers that have purchased the retail release of Curse of Black Bone.

Many players of the game were suggesting that the total finish time of the game is too short, so we have been able to add this scene aboard the 'Salty Wench' Warship that can be found between the unlocking of Anne Bonny taking the helm as captain of the ship and reaching the promised land of the planation scene. 

Upon allying the update, this bonus scene must be completed in order to reach the plantation and to finish the game. This additional scene will add a some overall playtime to extend the shortest possible path of players reaching the final scene of the game.

notes.title: Black Bone 1.06 update - FullScreen Mode
notes.content:
Black Bone 1.06 update - FullScreen Mode

This update addresses some of the formatting and text issues that some users were experiencing at various supported monitor resolutions.

- Options menu now included Fullscreen toggle
This toggle is active at the currently selected resolution in the options menu. These resolution settings include refresh rates. All settings are saved for future runs of the app. 

- Various dialogue corrections for typos and poorly spaced text.
We encourage any major mistakes that we have missed to be posted in the bugs section and they will be corrected in future update patches of the game. 

Thanks to Cantusbane for posting the alt+enter will toggle full screen quick keys toggle for Fullscreen. This alternate method of toggling Fullscreen mode remains active for users that prefer the quick keys method.
